detailed_findings.finding: The main argument constructs the involution T(b_1,...,b_m)=(m+1-b_1,...,m+1-b_m), and verifies that it flips the sign of every adjacent difference, yielding a bijection A(u) ↔ A(-u).
The special case m=0 is correctly discharged using the convention U_0(empty)=1; the case m=1 is covered by the general m>=1 argument since all sign constraints are vacuous.
The final alternating-pattern conclusion is a direct corollary of the proved identity together with the definition alt_m^- = -alt_m^+.

reason: The proof is correct and complete.
